title: Probing high-efficiency Cs0.05(FA0.77MA0.23)0.95Pb(I0.77Br0.23)3-based perovskite solar cells through first principles computations and SCAPS-1D simulation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7342-7353
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08323G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Okba Saidani, Souraya Goumri-Said, Abderrahim Yousfi, Girija Shankar Sahoo, Mohammed Benali Kanoun
This study presents a high-efficiency structure perovskite solar cell, incorporating a Cs0.05(FA0.77MA0.23)0.95Pb(I0.77Br0.23)3 as absorber, PCBM as the electron transport layer (ETL), and CuSbS2 as the hole transport layer (HTL).
